extracted_decision.summary: A Code Reviewer technical APPROVED verdict carrying PO_REVIEW_PENDING status satisfies the closure gate for this task; no separate live Manager sign-off is required.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Removing the human closure bottleneck keeps the pipeline moving, but final authority rests on a technical review that does not weigh UX or business intent.
